title: x509_cert_profile schema: tighten degenerate-case acceptance
description: Codereview edge-pass P4 on bedw.19. test/vectors/x509_cert_profile.schema.json accepts cases the generator never emits: (a) cases items require only name+description (payload-less case validates); (b) roles lacks uniqueItems; (c) hex patterns permit odd-length strings; (d) no uniqueness on case names. All mitigated by the byte-exact freshness oracle, so hardening nits not correctness gaps.
